clips.title: The story
paras: Inside Kharanos, Granis Swiftaxe trains young Alliance fighters from Coldridge Pass. The dwarf warrior trainer waits in the Thunderbrew Distillery, then sends seasoned warriors to Ironforge.

Granis Swiftaxe warms himself among the casks of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, where he trains young warriors crossing Dun Morogh. Proud of the warrior’s path, he openly amuses himself at those from other callings who try to win his attention. When a student proves their skill in combat, Granis sends them up the mountain path to Muren Stormpike, the master trainer in Ironforge’s Military Ward.
